# v1.5.0 — Legacy Docs Site + Docs Pipeline (CI-28–CI-30)

Released: 2026-05-25

## Added
- `CI-28`: Legacy static documentation site deploy workflow.
  - Full site at `mlops.zrl.dev`.
  - Strict-mode enabled; build fails on any broken ref or missing nav entry.

## Fixed
- `CI-29`: Resolved 10 legacy docs strict-mode warnings (broken anchors, nav mismatches).
- `CI-30`: Point `site_url` and Docs badge to `mlops.zrl.dev`; Semgrep SARIF seed.
- `CI-31`: Seed `semgrep.sarif` before Semgrep action step to prevent artifact-upload failure on clean runs.
- `CI-32`: Cast `RSAPrivateKey`/`RSAPublicKey` in `key_store.py` to satisfy mypy strict mode.
- `CI-33`: Use sentinel `_UNSET` in `_service_with_mock_repo` to avoid default-mutable-argument bug in test fixtures.
